setting.note: The 001000 study companion explicitly distinguishes the Depression-era 1930s fictional setting from 1960 publication. This broad decade does not identify one real prosecution as the fictional trial.

description: Connects Scout’s childhood to a racialized trial, examining community stories, law, exclusion, moral education, and narrative perspective. Covers A town, a porch, and a verdict; The writer and the two different historical moments; Who is actually telling this story?; The stories we inherit and the stories we revise.
